Body.Content:
What and Why:

We are updating the Brand Center setup experience so that administrators can set up Brand Center without enabling Public CDN.

Today, Public CDN is enabled as part of Brand Center setup, even when an organization only wants to use branding governance capabilities that do not require it. With this update, organizations can begin using Brand Center while deferring Public CDN until they need capabilities that depend on it, such as organizational fonts.

Rollout Schedule:

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in mid-October 2026 and expect to complete by late October 2026.

Impact on Your Organization:

When an administrator sets up Brand Center in the Microsoft 365 admin center:

  • Public CDN will be unselected by default.
  • Brand Center setup can be completed without Public CDN.
  • Public CDN will only be enabled after an administrator explicitly selects the option and confirms the change.
  • Font-related capabilities will remain unavailable until Public CDN is enabled.
  • If Public CDN is already enabled for the tenant, this update will not disable or change it.

This change separates Brand Center setup from Public CDN activation. It does not remove the Public CDN requirement for organizational fonts.

Why we are making this change

Some organizations want to begin using Brand Center for branding governance without introducing an external or public content-delivery dependency.

Making Public CDN optional provides a more incremental adoption path: organizations can establish Brand Center first and enable font capabilities only when they are ready.

Action Required/Recommendations:

No action is required. If your organization plans to use organizational fonts, an administrator must explicitly enable Public CDN during setup or later from the applicable settings experience.

  • Set up the SharePoint Brand Center
  • Use organizational fonts in SharePoint
  • Learn more about Microsoft 365 Public CDN

Compliance considerations:

Details.Value: Brand Center setup will no longer require enabling Public CDN by default, allowing organizations to use branding governance without it. Public CDN remains necessary for font features and must be explicitly enabled. This change rolls out worldwide in October 2026 with no action required unless fonts are used.
